A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RD-optimized 4D Gaussian Splatting work. Text extraction and rendered-page inspection support comparison of the methods, equations, figures, tables, and complete appendices A–H. v3 additionally includes a NeurIPS checklist.

before.justification: v2 reports original compression, rendering-quality, speed, and ablation results on N3V and Technicolor in Section 4 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical evaluations, including benchmark comparisons and component analyses, with revised entries in Tables 2 and 3.

M1.justification: The Ex4DGS-based procedure, Gaussian and SH pruning, quantization, Haar-wavelet trajectory compression, and optimization objectives are unchanged. The equations repeated after the new checklist introduce no method component.

E1.justification: All identifiable evaluations retain N3V and Technicolor, including the existing Light4GS comparison scenario. However, the added checklist claims training variance was checked on 'three datasets' without identifying a third dataset or its results. Whether this represents additional coverage is unresolved.

E2.justification: The comparator roster in Table 4, Ex4DGS comparison in Table 5, and Light4GS comparison in Appendix E are unchanged. Tables 2 and 3 also retain the same tested variants.

E3.justification: The stated metrics, compression settings, training schedule, and Light4GS-matched resolution and subset are unchanged. Appendix F retains the same explanation of separate pre-training for Tables 2 and 3; the numerical revisions do not establish changed settings or reruns.

E4.justification: The opacity, wavelet-depth, higher-fidelity, pruning, visualization, and storage analyses retain their questions and tested configurations. The substantive edits concern existing reference results and their interpretation, rather than additional ablations or robustness tests.

E5.justification: Checklist item 7 newly acknowledges absent statistical-significance reporting, attributes the cost of repeating all experiments to computational constraints, and asserts small training variance on three unspecified datasets. No run counts, seeds, variance estimates, confidence intervals, or estimation procedures are supplied.

E6.justification: Tables 2 and 3 revise the N3V L6 reference from 28.73 dB / 14.05 MB to 30.26 dB / 14.67 MB. The reduced-rate-loss variant remains 30.04 dB / 14.40 MB, changing its reported PSNR advantage into a 0.22 dB deficit. Other quantitative tables and figures are unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and loss formulations are retained. The total, vector-quantization, and entropy losses printed after the checklist repeat existing equations; no new assumptions, derivations, or proofs are introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same novelty, flexible rate-distortion control, and approximately 91-fold compression claims. The local ablation revision does not redefine these main contributions.

C2.justification: Section 4.3 replaces the claimed substantial benefit of reducing the rate-loss weight with little effect and a need for future improvements to the RD frontier. Appendix E nevertheless retains the old claim of a significant PSNR boost. Checklist item 11 also newly denies misuse risks despite the retained broader-impact discussion acknowledging malicious volumetric content.

D1.justification: Checklist items 5–6 newly state that supplementary code includes detailed configuration files and promise release of a pretrained model. The existing code link, hardware, training-time disclosures, and implementation settings remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish an actual new resource release.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, research references, novelty positioning, and relationship to Light4GS and other compression methods are unchanged. Added checklist policy links do not constitute new research positioning.

P1.justification: v3 appends a NeurIPS checklist and rewrites the higher-fidelity interpretation paragraph. The original section and appendix organization remains intact, with no extensive rewriting of the research narrative.

P2.justification: Local text and table wrapping changes on pages 9–10. The checklist adds a new formatted block ending with unnumbered copies of existing equations. Existing figures and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: Section 4.3 now interprets the revised Table 3 consistently, but Appendix E still cites that table for the opposite conclusion about reducing the rate-loss weight. The checklist adds disclosures while introducing an unexplained three-dataset variance claim and a misuse-risk statement inconsistent with the discussion. These mixed effects prevent a reliable net quality judgment.
